dictionary.ollama_remote_troubleshoot_title: How to unblock and connect remote Ollama:
dictionary.ollama_troubleshoot_ip_desc: If using WSL or VMs, 172.17.x.x addresses are virtual and not reachable from other LAN PCs. Use the real Wi-Fi/Ethernet LAN IP (run ipconfig on Windows, look for 192.168.x.x).
dictionary.ollama_troubleshoot_host_title: 2. Bind Ollama to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0)
dictionary.ollama_troubleshoot_host_desc: By default Ollama only listens on localhost (127.0.0.1). On the remote server, run in PowerShell:
dictionary.ollama_troubleshoot_firewall_desc: Allow inbound traffic on port 11434 on the remote host:
dictionary.manual_model_input_desc: If the remote server doesn't respond to auto-discovery or you already know the model name, enter it here to set it as default across Nuxiva.
dictionary.ollama_connectivity_hint: The server did not respond or returned no models. Verify the host/IP is reachable, the port is open, and Ollama is running with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 and OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*.
